{"proof":"subst v z
have hz : (2 : ℂ) - Complex.I ≠ 0 := by
  intro h
  have : Complex.I = 2 := sub_eq_zero.mp h
  have hI : Complex.I.re = (2 : ℂ).re := congrArg Complex.re this
  norm_num at hI
have hi : i = (1 + Complex.I) / (2 - Complex.I) := by
  rw [h₁] at h₀
  rw [h₀]
  exact (eq_div_iff hz).2 rfl
rw [hi]
field_simp
ring"}
